newsitem.title: USA: USDA raises Russia GSM-102 credit line by $20 mln.
newsitem.headline: USDA raises Russia GSM-102 credit line by $20 mln.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Wednesday said it raised Russia's GSM-102 credit guarantee line by $20 million to $70 million for fiscal year 1997.

Earlier this month, USDA said Russia had expressed interest in buying U.S. wheat and/or wheat flour and that the department would consider increasing its GSM-102 credit allocations once a remaining $25 million allocation was utilized.
